title: Total Revenue by Day of Week
description:
Calculate the **total revenue** for each day of the week across all orders. Use `EXTRACT(DOW FROM order_date)` where 0 = Sunday, 1 = Monday, …, 6 = Saturday.

**Table: orders** — `order_id`, `order_date`, `revenue`

Output columns: `day_of_week`, `total_revenue`. Order by `day_of_week`.
solution_sql: SELECT EXTRACT(DOW FROM order_date)::INTEGER AS day_of_week, SUM(revenue) AS total_revenue FROM orders GROUP BY EXTRACT(DOW FROM order_date) ORDER BY day_of_week;

test_cases.description: 7 distinct days of week covered; Jan 1 2024 is Monday (DOW=1), Jan 7 is Sunday (DOW=0)

hints: EXTRACT(DOW FROM date) returns the numeric day of week (0=Sunday through 6=Saturday) in DuckDB.
GROUP BY the EXTRACT expression to aggregate revenue per day of week.
Cast the result to INTEGER with ::INTEGER so the output column is a clean integer rather than a float.
explanation: Jan 1, 2024 is a Monday (DOW=1). The 12 orders span both weeks so all 7 days of the week are covered. Monday (DOW=1): 100+120=220. Tuesday (DOW=2): 150+180=330. Wednesday (DOW=3): 200+220=420. Thursday (DOW=4): 175+160=335. Friday (DOW=5): 300+340=640. Saturday (DOW=6): 250. Sunday (DOW=0): 80.
